⚠️Typhoon Kalmaegi Devastates Cebu: At Least 85 Dead, State of Calamity Declared

Typhoon Kalmaegi (locally “Tino”) struck the central Philippines, especially Cebu Province, leaving at least 85 people dead and 75 missing amid unprecedented flooding and landslides. The province declared a state of calamity as residents face mass evacuations, thousands stranded, and flying debris.
